blind_input_boundary: Only original objective/obligations, archived baseline/candidate/diff, public checks, outcome-only private result, edit/custody/effect facts and separately approved current source. No B-0051 diagnostic or private counterexample implementation.

host_only_scoring.provenance: Sealed B-0050 private outcome plus exact archived-candidate causal reproduction, retained before this review.

host_only_scoring.required: Check each concrete claim against exact candidate/current source and public check chronology. Distinguish independently discovered, already public, unsupported/incorrect and unresolved claims. Model observed/inference labels are not host verification.

A truthful inability to locate the defect is valid. One same-weight fresh session does not establish broad reviewer competence or diversity. No prompt tuning, repeat sample, coding repair or candidate eligibility follows.
